datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Kenya in 2014, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases based on standardized assessment protocols. Data were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) representing medium-term projections for January, April, July, and October 2014, with multiple scenarios indicating different assistance and food security outcomes.
